author: More Perfect Union
description:
BREAKING: Mississippi just elected its first Democratic senator in over 4 decades, and its first Black Senator in over 150 years.

Scott Colom might be the biggest upset of these midterms, and he ran on fighting for healthcare, raising the minimum wage, rejecting AIPAC money and more.
title: HUGE: Mississippi Democrat Scott Colom wins Senate race on platform for working people

author: More Perfect Union
description:
The VA is paying Larry Ellison billions for a computer system that doesn’t work, and veteran deaths are rising.

In 2017, Jared and Ivanka said they’d fix the VA. What they meant was privatization.

So Kushner got a company called Cerner a no-bid $10 billion health IT contract. Then, Larry Ellison bought Cerner.

The system Cerner implemented is so bad it’s killing vets, but the VA is still paying the Ellisons $100 million a month, and under Trump his company was just awarded another $17 billion contract.

Now, veterans are fighting back and organizing to freeze these funds.

If you want to learn more or get involved in this campaign visit stoptherollout.org

Producer: Mae Ryan
Editor, Motion Graphics: Gina Barton
Videographer: Ryan Scott
Supervising Producer: Court Fuller
title: Jared Kushner's plan is KILLING veterans and making this billionaire even richer

author: More Perfect Union
description:
Angie Nixon came within 3 points of winning a Florida Senate seat running on a campaign of Medicare for All and universal jobs. 

Was she really the "wrong" candidate for the sate? 

The numbers tell a different story.

title: We checked the establishment’s math on Florida. They were wrong.

author: More Perfect Union
description:
Last year, Republicans decided to kick millions of people off health care.

Voters were furious. And in many of the districts hardest hit by health care cuts, GOP candidates got crushed.

Now, Democrats have a chance to deliver on a mandate for real change to a broken system.
